questions.question: Name two benefits of niacinamide for the skin.
questions.model_answer: Niacinamide (vitamin B3) controls excess oil (sebum), makes enlarged pores look smaller, evens skin tone and fades dark marks, and strengthens the skin barrier.
questions.grading_notes: Four key points: (1) controls oil, (2) minimises pores, (3) evens tone or fades dark marks, (4) strengthens the skin barrier.
